records.text: In 2009 FBI agents recovered a cooler of cash buried at Summit Hills Country Club that Bill Erpenbeck intended to use after prison
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep cZxHqYsWRYg)

appearances.snippet: The Erpenbeck name was back in the news in 2009 when FBI agents dug up a cooler full of cash from Summit Hills Country Club in Crestview Hills. ... A friend had buried money that he received from Erpenbeck on the course next to Erpenbeck's former home. ... Erpenbeck had hoped to use that money after he got out of prison.

verification.notes: The Sixth Circuit's 2012 opinion states that FBI agents found more than 250,000 dollars in a cooler buried at a private golf course and that it was being held for Bill Erpenbeck until his release. Current reporting identifies the Summit Hills site and 2009 recovery.

sources.title: United States v. A. William Erpenbeck, Jr. (Sixth Circuit, 2012)
sources.relevance: Official opinion documents the FBI recovery of more than 250,000 dollars buried in a cooler for Erpenbeck's later use.
